sections.h2: What East Village homes are like
paragraphs: East Village is on the newer side of Bee Cave. The homes are built between 2,000 and 3,400 square feet and priced from about $900K to $1.1M, with no gate and no HOA listed. The location is the draw: groceries, restaurants and school routes are a short trip away. Expect two story plans with stone or stucco fronts, covered porches, and big windows in the living room and primary suite. Lots are smaller than the older estate neighborhoods, so homes sit closer together and yards are compact but landscaped.
Closer lots also mean neighbors can schedule at the same time, which is useful for us.

sections.h2: What East Village windows deal with
paragraphs: Newer glass should be easy, and it is, as long as it is cleaned on a steady schedule. The things we see in a growing area are construction dust from building nearby, road dust from busy streets, and landscape sprinklers aimed too close to the wall. Hard water leaves white spots on ground level glass and, left alone for a couple of years, can start to etch. Young trees have not reached the roofline yet, so the sun hits glass directly in the afternoon and brings out streaks. Cedar and live oak pollen each take their turn in winter and spring.
Screens and sliding door tracks collect grit quickly in this kind of setting.

There is no gate, so we pull up and start. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which covers every window on a typical two story house without a ladder on the exterior. Inside, we use drop cloths and hand squeegees, with cotton covered ladders on the stairwell windows. Since homes are close together, we can clean two or three on the same street in one visit when neighbors coordinate. That also helps with the route toward Lakeway, where we are based. Many East Village owners add tracks and screens, and a driveway wash at $0.18 per square foot for concrete.
At 2,800 square feet in East Village, exterior glass comes to about $280. Budget two to three hours outside in East Village and roughly ninety minutes inside.
